INSERT INTO recommendation_impressions (user_id, track_id, surface, wave_session_id, model_version, score,
                                                 reason, position)
         SELECT $1, t, $2, $3, $4, s, r::jsonb, p
         FROM unnest($5::uuid[], $6::real[], $7::text[], $8::int[]) AS x(t, s, r, p)
